name: Raspberry Pi Pico

outline.source: Raspberry Pi Pico datasheet, mechanical specification (Raspberry Pi Ltd): 51 x 21 mm; corner radius approximate (about 2 mm), not yet checked against the drawing

pcb.source: Raspberry Pi Pico datasheet, mechanical specification (Raspberry Pi Ltd): single-sided 1 mm PCB; not yet checked against the drawing

mounting_holes.source: Raspberry Pi Pico datasheet, mechanical specification (Raspberry Pi Ltd): four 2.1 mm holes, 47.0 x 11.4 mm pattern 2.0 / 4.8 mm from the edges (recalled, not yet checked against the drawing); pad_diameter 3.4 is an assumed keep-out ring because the micro-USB shell is close to the hole

connectors.name: micro-USB
connectors.source: micro-B receptacle centred on the short edge (y = 10.5 mm), overhanging about 1.5 mm; total height 3.9 mm

omitted: BOOTSEL button and LED (no wall opening unless the user needs button access)
castellated edge pads and soldered header pins
